content: {"reasoning":"Prior auth is required but missing, and silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, so those routes are unavailable and would be process errors. An appeal requires a denial on the table, which does not yet exist, and billing the patient or writing off would forfeit collectible revenue on an eligible, active, correctly-ordered claim with 154 days of filing time left. The only way to progress is to put the claim in front of the payer; attaching the supporting clinical records (documentation quality 0.85) gives the best chance of payment on an auth-less claim and builds the record for a medical-necessity appeal if it is denied.","action":"submit_with_records"}
